notes: **D6 DECIDED (c) and implemented (Architect-ratified 2026-08-22)** — the staleness nudge. New `gator_core.policy_staleness_nudge(gator_dir, now, stale_days)` (both copies, block-mirrored): purely LOCAL check — `is_enterprise_active` gate → mtime of `~/.gator/enterprise/org-policies.json` vs threshold (7 days default; `GATOR_POLICY_STALE_DAYS` env) → one-line nudge or None; never raises; NO network in any session-opening path (the whole point of (c): freshness failures are visible staleness, never a blown hook timeout or a silent success-looking failure).
